caseName: United States v. Mossel. Same v. Milford
caseNameFull: United States v. Mossel; United States v. Milford
attorneys: Mr. James A. Fowler, Special Assistant to the Attorney-General, with whom Mr. Solicitor General Beck was on the brief, for the United States., Mr. George A. King, with whom Mr. William B. King and Mr. George R. Shields were on the brief, for appellees.

opinions.author: McKenna
opinions.text:
Mr. Justice McKenna

delivered the judgment of the Court.

Under stipulation of counsel, filed in the Clerk’s Office, the above cases are submitted on the record as printed in United States v. Luskey, No. 371, just decided, ante, 62, “ it being agreed by counsel that they shall be controlled by the decision in that case.”

Therefore, upon its authority, the judgments in these cases are

Affirmed.
